text_en: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples; and after encouraging them and saying farewell, he left for Macedonia.
text_cn: 暴动平息后，保禄便派人去叫门徒们来，劝勉一番，就辞别他们，出发往马其顿去。

text_en: When he had gone through those regions and had given the believers much encouragement, he came to Greece,
text_cn: 他走遍了那一带地方，多方劝勉信徒后，就到了希腊，

text_en: where he stayed for three months. He was about to set sail for Syria when a plot was made against him by the Jews, and so he decided to return through Macedonia.
text_cn: 在那里住了三个月。当他正要乘船去叙利亚时，犹太人却设计陷害他，他遂决意经马其顿回去。

text_en: He was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Beroea, by Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, by Gaius from Derbe, and by Timothy, as well as by Tychicus and Trophimus from Asia.
text_cn: 伴随他【到亚细亚】的，有贝洛雅人丕洛的儿子索帕特尔，得撒洛尼人阿黎斯塔苛和色贡多，德尔贝人加约和弟茂德，还有亚细亚人提希苛和特洛斐摩。

text_en: They went ahead and were waiting for us in Troas;
text_cn: 这些人先去了，在特洛阿等候我们；

text_en: but we sailed from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and in five days we joined them in Troas, where we stayed for seven days.
text_cn: 至于我们，无酵节后，才从斐理伯启航，直到第五天才抵达特洛阿，到了他们那里，在那里住了七天。

text_en: On the first day of the week, when we met to break bread, Paul was holding a discussion with them; since he intended to leave the next day, he continued speaking until midnight.
text_cn: 一周的第一天，我们相聚擘饼时，保禄便向民众讲道，因为他第二天要走，遂把话拖长，直到半夜。

text_en: There were many lamps in the room upstairs where we were meeting.
text_cn: 在我们聚会的那座楼上，有许多灯。

text_en: A young man named Eutychus, who was sitting in the window, began to sink off into a deep sleep while Paul talked still longer. Overcome by sleep, he fell to the ground three floors below and was picked up dead.
text_cn: 有个青年名叫厄乌提曷，坐在窗台上，因保禄讲道稍长，就沉沉欲睡；及至熟睡后，就从三楼堕下；扶起来时，已经死了。

text_en: But Paul went down, and bending over him took him in his arms, and said, “Do not be alarmed, for his life is in him. ”
text_cn: 保禄下来，伏在他身上，抱住他说：“你们不要慌乱，因为他的灵魂还在他身上呢。”

text_en: Then Paul went upstairs, and after he had broken bread and eaten, he continued to converse with them until dawn; then he left.
text_cn: 遂上去，擘开饼，吃了。又谈了很久，直到天亮，这才出发。

text_en: Meanwhile they had taken the boy away alive and were not a little comforted.
text_cn: 他们把活了的孩子领去，都非常快慰。

text_en: We went ahead to the ship and set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul on board there; for he had made this arrangement, intending to go by land himself.
text_cn: 我们上船先行，直向阿索航去，要从那里接保禄上船；因为他这样规定，自己要走陆路。

text_en: When he met us in Assos, we took him on board and went to Mitylene.
text_cn: 当他在阿索与我们会合时，我们便接他上船，来到米提肋乃。

text_en: We sailed from there, and on the following day we arrived opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos, and the day after that we came to Miletus.
text_cn: 从那里航行，次日到了希约对面，次日再向撒摩驶去，次日就到了米肋托。

text_en: For Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus, so that he might not have to spend time in Asia; he was eager to be in Jerusalem, if possible, on the day of Pentecost.
text_cn: 因为保禄已决定驶过厄弗所，免得在亚细亚耽搁时间；原来他想赶程前行，假如可能，愿在耶路撒冷过五旬节。

text_en: From Miletus he sent a message to Ephesus, asking the elders of the church to meet him.
text_cn: 保禄从米肋托打发人到厄弗所，请教会的长老来。

text_en: When they came to him, he said to them: “You yourselves know how I lived among you the entire time from the first day that I set foot in Asia,
text_cn: 他们到了他那里，他便向他们说：“你们知道：自从我来到亚细亚的第一天起，与你们在一起，始终怎样为人，

text_en: serving the Lord with all humility and with tears, enduring the trials that came to me through the plots of the Jews.
text_cn: 怎样以极度的谦逊，含着眼泪，历经犹太人为我所设的阴谋，而忠信事奉主。

text_en: I did not shrink from doing anything helpful, proclaiming the message to you and teaching you publicly and from house to house,
text_cn: 你们也知道：凡有益于你们的事，我没有一样隐讳而不传给你们的，我常在公众前，或挨家教训你们，

text_en: as I testified to both Jews and Greeks about repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
text_cn: 不论向犹太人或希腊人，我常苦劝你们悔改，归向天主，并信从吾主耶稣。

text_en: And now, as a captive to the Spirit, I am on my way to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there,
text_cn: 看，现在，我为圣神所束缚，必须往耶路撒冷去，在那里要遇到什么事，我不知道；

text_en: except that the Holy Spirit testifies to me in every city that imprisonment and persecutions are waiting for me.
text_cn: 我只知道圣神在各城中向我指明说：有锁链和患难在等待我。

text_en: But I do not count my life of any value to myself, if only I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the good news of God’s grace.
text_cn: 可是，只要我完成了我的行程，完成了受自主耶稣叫我给天主恩宠的福音作证的任务，我没有任何理由，珍惜我的性命。

text_en: “And now I know that none of you, among whom I have gone about proclaiming the kingdom, will ever see my face again.
text_cn: 我曾在你们中往来，宣讲了天主的国，但现在，我知道你们众人以后不得再见我的面了。

text_en: Therefore I declare to you this day that I am not responsible for the blood of any of you,
text_cn: 因此，我今天向你们作证：对于众人的血，我是无罪的，

text_en: for I did not shrink from declaring to you the whole purpose of God.
text_cn: 因为天主的一切计划，我都传告给你们了，毫无隐讳。

text_en: Keep watch over yourselves and over all the flock, of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God that he obtained with the blood of his own Son.
text_cn: 圣神既在全群中立你们为监督，牧养天主用自己的血所取得的教会，所以你们要对你们自己和整个羊群留心。

text_en: I know that after I have gone, savage wolves will come in among you, not sparing the flock.
text_cn: 我知道在我离开之后，将有凶暴的豺狼进到你们中间，不顾惜羊群，

text_en: Some even from your own group will come distorting the truth in order to entice the disciples to follow them.
text_cn: 就是在你们中间，也要有人起来讲说谬论，勾引门徒跟随他们。

text_en: Therefore be alert, remembering that for three years I did not cease night or day to warn everyone with tears.
text_cn: 因此，你们要警醒，记住我三年之久，日夜不断地含泪劝勉了你们每一个人。

text_en: And now I commend you to God and to the message of his grace, a message that is able to build you up and to give you the inheritance among all who are sanctified.
text_cn: 现在，我把你们托付给天主和他恩宠之道，他能建立你们，并在一切圣徒中，赐给你们嗣业。

text_en: I coveted no one’s silver or gold or clothing.
text_cn: 我没有贪图过任何人的金银或衣服。

text_en: You know for yourselves that I worked with my own hands to support myself and my companions.
text_cn: 你们自己知道：这双手供应了我，和同我一起的人的需要。

text_en: In all this I have given you an example that by such work we must support the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus, for he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive. ’”
text_cn: 在各方面我都给你们立了榜样，就是必须这样劳动，扶助病弱者；要记住主耶稣的话，他说过：‘施予比领受更为有福。’”

text_en: When he had finished speaking, he knelt down with them all and prayed.
text_cn: 说完这些话，便跪下同众人祈祷。

text_en: There was much weeping among them all; they embraced Paul and kissed him,
text_cn: 众人都大哭起来，并伏在保禄的颈项上，口亲他。

text_en: grieving especially because of what he had said, that they would not see him again. Then they brought him to the ship.
text_cn: 他们最伤心的，是为了保禄说的这句话：以后他们不得再见他的面了。他们便送他上了船。
